Our Story

Made in the Shoals

Copperhead Laser Co. is a hometown operation right here in Killen, Alabama. We're not a franchise, not a fulfillment center — just a craftsman with precision tools and a passion for making things that last.

Whether it's a wedding favor, a closing gift, a branded corporate item, or a one-of-a-kind keepsake, every order is handled personally from proof to production.

We engrave on wood, leather, slate, acrylic, coated metal, ceramic, fabric, and cork — and we can handle everything from a single piece to standing business accounts.

How It Works

1
Submit Your Request Fill out the form with your item, quantity, and personalization details. Attach any files or photos you want engraved.
2
Get a Proof & Quote We'll send you a digital proof and final pricing. No surprises — nothing moves forward without your approval.
3
We Engrave It Once approved, most orders are ready in 48–72 hours. Rush options available.
4
Pickup or Local Delivery Based in Killen — no shipping delays for Shoals customers. Delivery throughout the area available. Shipping throughout North America also available.

Questions

FAQ

No minimums on personal orders — one piece is perfectly fine. Business and bulk orders have a minimum of 10 units for bulk pricing to apply.
We accept JPG, PNG, PDF, SVG, AI, EPS, and DXF files. Vector files (SVG, AI, EPS, DXF) give the best results. If you only have a photo or an idea, we can work with that too — just describe what you want and we'll create a proof.
Most orders are ready within 48–72 hours of proof approval. Rush orders are available — call or text us directly to discuss your timeline and availability.
Always. Every single order gets a digital proof sent to you for approval before we touch the material. Nothing is engraved without your sign-off. No surprises.
We engrave on wood, genuine leather, slate, acrylic, coated metal, ceramic, fabric, and cork. Not sure if your material works? Just ask — we're happy to tell you upfront.
Yes! Businesses and agents who order regularly can set up a standing account. Benefits include priority turnaround, per-unit pricing locked for 6 months, your logo on file, and direct-to-door delivery throughout the Shoals area. Ask about it on your first order.
We're based in Killen and primarily serve the Shoals area with in-person delivery — no middlemen or shipping delays for local customers. For customers outside the area, shipping can be arranged. Ask when you place your order.
In many cases, yes. Items like knife sets (we engrave the handles for wedding cake sets), tumblers, and similar items can be brought in. Reach out first so we can confirm the material is compatible with our equipment.
